name: Devraj
notes: A retired maritime telegraph operator and lens-grinder of the Vengi marsh docks in late Epoch 4, seventy when the ground broke. His lenses became the Kelpfang-II's solar cookers; on the Night of Red Teeth the Dhol dragged him into the dark and nothing was found but his calipers. Ananya built a memorial shrine for him on the river terrace; his lenses later lit the Ark. One of the Founding Three.
